releaseNotes:
Pauso 0.15.0 — Quiet turntable

- Darker Player, Music and Settings pages with icon-only bottom navigation and less explanatory text.
- Layered vinyl artwork, long curved tonearm, counterclockwise rotation and subtle record wobble. The live timer and light stay fixed; the arm lifts during silence. Reduce motion is available in Settings.
- Tap empty Player space to hide/show controls. Compact rhythm control, moon Sleep entry and a discreet player-volume control.
- Noise and Nature cards remember the last sound selected in each category.
- Long-press songs for selection, select all visible results, and remove multiple playlist entries without deleting audio files.
- Playlist Shuffle can start on a random track.

Existing rhythms, playlists, file access, volume and Sleep behavior are retained. Install over the existing app; do not uninstall first.

Validation: automated build, signing, regression and artwork-composition checks passed. Physical-device visual/performance review remains pending. Folder browsing, active-playback sound audition, Wake mode and video are not included.
